description: This file contains the definition of the PutObjectUrlMiddleware class, which is part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It implements a middleware that injects the Object URL into the result of certain S3 operations, notably PutObject, CopyObject, and CompleteMultipartUpload.

classes.name: PutObjectUrlMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that enhances the AWS S3 command results by injecting the Object URL into the result, based on the command executed.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper function that returns an instance of PutObjectUrlMiddleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Magic method that processes the command and request, attaches a callback to add ObjectURL to the result based on the command type.
